name: performance-load-runtime-proof
truth_boundary: This contract proves only hosted regression behavior observed on a GitHub-hosted Ubuntu Docker Compose runner. It is not a production capacity benchmark, SLA/SLO guarantee, target-PC result, network-edge benchmark, or physical-hardware certification.

checks.claim: Gateway actuator health reports UP before the load profiles.
Identity-service actuator health reports UP before the load profiles.
User-service actuator health reports UP before the load profiles.
A real API consumer session is created through the gateway and used for protected load.
Protected reads complete before timing and materialize the Redis users-list cache.
The configured concurrent burst request set completes and is fully observed.
The configured sustained authenticated read profile completes and is fully observed.
Each hosted profile stays at or below the conservative configured error-rate guardrail.
Each hosted profile stays at or below the conservative configured p95 latency guardrail.
Each hosted profile remains above the conservative configured throughput floor.
Raw p50, p95, p99 and max latency observations are recorded for every profile.
Gateway health continues reporting UP while the sustained profile is running.
Gateway, identity-service and user-service report UP after load completes.
A protected gateway read succeeds after the load profiles complete.
The read-only benchmark leaves the protected user-list state unchanged.
Evidence explicitly remains HOSTED_RUNTIME and makes no production-capacity or physical-PC claim.
